_comment: Known differences from real tsc (--strict + extras). A FALSE POSITIVE (tsox flags an error tsc does not) or a MISMATCH (both report an error on a line but the code or message differs) that is not listed fails the merge gate; a GAP (tsc catches something tsox does not check yet) is the remaining work and is only reported. Generate or refresh knownDifferences with: node scripts/ts-diag-tool/compare.js tests/fixtures target/release/tsox --json --differ --only-differ | node scripts/ts-diag-tool/check-baseline.js --update . Until knownDifferences exists, the old count check (maxFalsePositive) is used; --update removes it. See check-baseline.js for the entry format.
_notes: Known false positive: tests/fixtures/builtin-generics/promise_member_access_correctly_reports_missing_property.ts -- Promise<T> is a deliberately opaque, unmodeled type (no .then()/await support yet), so accessing .then on it is honestly reported as missing even though real tsc's Promise has it; that fixture's own comment documents this as an intentional, expected divergence, the same category as array_indexing_dynamic_key_includes_undefined.ts. If/when Promise gets real .then() modeling, this entry should disappear on the next --update.
